description: This file contains unit tests for the NessusOutputProcessor class, verifying its ability to parse vulnerability data from Nessus scan result XML files.

classes.name: NessusOutputProcessorTest
classes.description: A test class extending ParserTestCase to verify NessusOutputProcessor's parsing functionalities.

methods.name: testParseVulnerabilities
methods.description: Tests parsing of vulnerabilities from a sample Nessus XML report and verifies count and remediation field.

methods.name: testParseVulnerabilitiesIncludingCvssData
methods.description: Tests parsing of vulnerabilities including CVSS data, verifying count, CVSS score, and vector.
